top_news.title: Robust XGBoosting for Regression
top_news.dek: Researchers analyze the robustness of XGBoost against vertical outliers and leverage points in regression tasks.
top_news.brief: The study examines how standard XGBoost implementations perform under non-ideal data conditions. While quadratic loss is standard, the authors investigate the impact of outliers on model stability and performance, providing insights for more robust gradient boosting applications.

top_news.title: Stripe Clinches over $7B Deal to Buy AI Firm OpenRouter
top_news.dek: Stripe is reportedly in advanced talks to acquire AI gateway provider OpenRouter for over $7 billion.
top_news.brief: The potential acquisition signals Stripe's intent to deepen its infrastructure play in the AI ecosystem. OpenRouter acts as a unified API gateway for various LLMs, a service that aligns with Stripe's focus on developer-centric financial and technical infrastructure.

top_news.title: Stripe will reportedly acquire AI gateway startup OpenRouter for $7B+

By acquiring the startup, Stripe aims to capture the middleware layer of the AI stack, positioning itself as the primary gateway for AI-driven commerce and applications.

top_news.title: I Played ARC-AGI-3 With My Own Method
top_news.dek: A new approach to the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark achieves significant success using Claude Code.
top_news.brief: Testing an iterative loop method on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, researchers achieved an 18/25 win rate on public games. The experiment utilized the arc-code repository, demonstrating that current LLM-based agents can effectively solve complex grid-based reasoning tasks through structured prompting and execution loops.
